notes.title: Dev Update #2 - Adding Small Maps and More
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We're back with another exciting update![/p][p][/p][p]This time, we've added small variants for all three current maps, giving each one a fresh twist. We've also introduced a new lobby settings menu, allowing you to choose exactly which gamemodes and maps you want to play.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579200/f97d8f2882346aac105e14bb8c53b887acac4571.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579200/670391676cafc895c95c37b199e75dddd21fd0b1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579200/77dd704f8107e744649f5c5bfa7a7f03852b37d4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579200/27f9a9ed93b5cdfd574653035ec8437c0b1b8ea8.png"][/img][/p][p]On top of that, there's now a pregame screen that shows key information about the upcoming round and explains the rules of the gamemode you're about to play, so everyone’s on the same page before the chaos begins![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579200/75aabfb13ff3236e798651460848c05f2bc6201c.png"][/img][/p][p]And there's more on the way! Our next update will bring local multiplayer and full controller support, so stay tuned![/p][p]— The Chunky Pixel Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Buckle Up! Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're excited to announce that the Buckle Up! demo is now available to play!

This demo features 4 unique game modes and 3 distinct maps, all designed for 2 to 6 players. Whether you're teaming up with friends or diving into chaos with strangers, there's plenty of fun to be had. Best of all, the demo is unlimited, so you can play as much as you like.

Over the next few weeks we’ll be focusing on bug fixes and gameplay improvements based on your feedback. If you'd like to help us playtest or report any bugs, please join us on our Discord server. We truly appreciate your support.

We hope you enjoy the demo and stay tuned for more updates coming soon.

Thank you
 Chunky Pixel Games team

notes.title: Dev Update #1 - Adding Menus and UI
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’ve added the first batch of in-game menus to Buckle Up! along with animations to bring them to life. It’s a big step toward making the game feel complete. More UI improvements are coming soon, so stay tuned!
